crossRefs.note: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.
Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that…
nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.
that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.
For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole…

translations.web: Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.
translations.bsb: My inmost being will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.
translations.kjv: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips speak right things.
translations.asv: Yea, my heart will rejoice, When thy lips speak right things.
